ApplicationApiKeysPanel owns one application credential lifecycle: the scoped key query, create/revoke mutations, create form and one-time created token. Its panel and embedded variants share the same keyTable and transactions; the repeated JSX is presentation of those same modal states, not a second backend owner. Both writes guard their individual operation and invalidate applicationApiKeysQueryKey plus applicationDetailQueryKey. Closing the secret modal clears createdKey and no storage/URL persistence exists. application-api-page tests cover exact create/revoke grants, read-only key inspection and a token shown once without storage/URL writes.
